title: Fake clock, fake read

blocks.md:
## Do not wait on the real clock

`report(deps)` should call `deps.clock()` and `deps.read("log.txt")`. In tests you pass `{ clock: () => 1000, read: () => "north" }`. You do not call `Date.now()` or `fs` inside `report`.

Print `1000 north`. The hidden test will pass a different clock and a different `read`. If you touch the real disk, that test cannot control the bytes.

The desk stamps a log with a fake noon so the fox walk test does not wait for a real midnight file.

choices.md: Needs the real disk every time
Controls the bytes without a real file

blocks.promptMd: `report` should call `fs.readFileSync` so the test always hits the real disk.
blocks.explainMd: Pass read in. The test supplies the bytes. report only concatenates clock() and that text.

blocks.promptMd: > `report({ clock, read })` prints `clock() + " " + read("log.txt")`. Use 1000 and north.

hintLadder.md: `report` only talks to `deps`. It does not import `fs` or `Date`.
Call `deps.clock()` and `deps.read("log.txt")`. Join them with a space.
Do not call Date.now() or fs in report — use deps.
